u0: Quiet state: the siren is currently off and there is no active alarm to handle. Continue normal shop tasks (orders, fetching, preparing, serving) while staying alert; if the siren starts ringing without being switched off this step, the task moves to the alarm-response state.
u1: Alarm active: the siren is ringing and has not yet been silenced. The immediate objective is to navigate to the siren switch and toggle it to turn the siren off; other shop work is secondary until the siren is handled.
u2: Siren handled: the alarm was just switched off (or its ring lapsed), completing the current response. Resume ordinary shop activity, but remain ready to react again the next time the siren starts ringing by returning to the alarm-response state.
